purpose: Locks the ordinary-message branch of the exact Phi-4-mini-instruct GGUF chat template. Tool-bearing system messages use the generic metadata-Jinja renderer; this pack covers the dedicated compact fallback used when no tools are supplied.

oracle.template: {% for message in messages %}{% if message['role'] == 'system' and 'tools' in message and message['tools'] is not none %}{{ '<|' + message['role'] + '|>' + message['content'] + '<|tool|>' + message['tools'] + '<|/tool|>' + '<|end|>' }}{% else %}{{ '<|' + message['role'] + '|>' + message['content'] + '<|end|>' }}{% endif %}{% endfor %}{% if add_generation_prompt %}{{ '<|assistant|>' }}{% else %}{{ eos_token }}{% endif %}
